description: Extension of alkene/alkyne benchmark to peptide bond models. Demonstrates that peptide bonds require alkyne-level ADAPT-VQE treatment.

results.ramachandran_relevance: C=O pi bond; partial N donation; planar geometry constraint
Full Ca-C(O)-N-Ca unit; defines phi/psi energy surface
Direct phi/psi surface; determines secondary structure propensity

key_finding: UCCSD-VQE error escalates to 12.6 mHa for alanine dipeptide — 8x worse than ethylene. ADAPT-VQE maintains chemical accuracy (<1.6 mHa) on all peptide targets with 3.2-4.1x shallower circuits. Peptide bonds follow the same correlation energy scaling trend as alkynes (R2=0.69 across full 9-molecule series).
